metadata.summary: A toy Skill-uplift Climb. It runs the synthetic BranchCode v1 task family twice — once without a Skill, once with one — so you can see what writing a procedure down changes. This is an introductory demonstration of the mechanism, not a measure of broad capability. This development build has not yet chosen the model that answers, so its numbers are not evidence.
